Domestic customers span farmers, small and medium businesses, construction users, and corporate/institutional buyers across urban, semi-urban and rural India, supported by promotional and demonstration activity including dedicated demonstration vans. risks.note: Subsidy policies of state and central governments and the associated complex disbursement processes delay timely delivery of goods to end customers; FY 2025-26 was challenging for the tiller market as customers deferred purchases in anticipation of scheme releases that were subsequently delayed.
risks.risk: Government subsidy scheme delays holding back farm-equipment demand

risks.note: The influx of low-cost imported brush cutters has disrupted market pricing, forcing the Company to defend on total cost of operation and quality messaging rather than price.
risks.risk: Low-cost imports, primarily from China, disrupting brush-cutter pricing

risks.note: Frequent changes in USA import tariffs have impacted certainty and price competitiveness, potentially influencing demand and order inflows, while stricter CARB/EPA/CPSC regulations are impacting prospective sales — a direct exposure given exports contribute 22% of total turnover.
risks.risk: US import tariff volatility and tightening overseas product regulation

risks.note: BRSR flags a continuing challenge from the dynamic and evolving landscape of global environmental regulations, where compliance requires substantial investment in infrastructure, continuous updates on legal frameworks and awareness-building among process stakeholders.
risks.risk: Evolving global environmental regulation raising compliance cost

risks.note: Peak power deficit continues to be within acceptable levels due to adequate power generation, so interim demand in urban areas driven by long-haul power cuts has been on a reducing trend — eroding the traditional core driver of generator sales.
risks.risk: Structural erosion of urban backup-power demand

risks.note: Consumer spending remains low due to higher interest rates, and corporate/institutional demand remained subdued during the year due to deferment of funds.
risks.risk: Weak consumer spending and discretionary demand

risks.note: A key challenge especially in new and emerging export markets where price sensitivity is high.
risks.risk: Competition from global players with optimized supply chains and aggressive pricing

risks.note: BRSR identifies the process as evolved with technical inputs and support from Honda Motor Co., Ltd., Japan under a technical collaboration agreement — a significant entry barrier for new entrants, but also a structural dependency the Company's access to best-available processes rests on.
risks.risk: Dependence on Honda Motor Co., Ltd., Japan for manufacturing process and technology
